India to Supply Electricity to Nepal Amid Flood Recovery

India will supply Nepal with 18 hours of electricity daily to aid its recovery following recent floods. The agreement aims to provide a power backup for Nepal as it deals with the aftermath of the natural disaster. Thousands of people remain missing in Nepal as flood recovery efforts continue.
